Subject: Quick ask — per-1M token IO rates + model roster for Hosted API

Hi Sean,

We are kicking off an evaluation of embedding and chat flows for a clinical triage assistant at Novum Health. Before we build a quick POC, procurement asked me for a straightforward baseline: what are your standard per-1M token rates split by input/output for the Hosted API, and which model families are available today (small/med/large)?

Expected first-phase usage: ~2M tokens/day (mix of prompt + responses), with an expected ramp to ~50M tokens/month within 6–9 months if latency and cost look good.

Also curious:
- Do you publish a public model catalog with IO pricing mapped to each model?
- What pilot discounts or credits do you typically offer for a 6–8 week POC?
- Are embeddings priced differently (per 1k vectors / per-token)?

If you can send a one-pager or a single line summary I can share with procurement today, that would be great. We may loop in an SOW later.

Thanks — Alicia

Subject: Re: Quick ask — per-1M token IO rates + model roster for Hosted API

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer below (one-line summary first, then a couple examples). I attached our standard PDF rate card and a short commit scenarios workbook.

One-line summary: Hosted API IO split pricing (input/output) — baseline list rates: $1.00 per 1M input tokens, $2.50 per 1M output tokens for our mid-tier family; smaller models ~50–70% of that; large LLMs ~2–3x. Embeddings are billed separately (see below).

Model families available (hosted): RW-small (2–4B), RW-mid (7–13B), RW-large (70B+), Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B. Full catalog + latency/perf profiles: https://redwood.example.com/models/catalog

Example IO list rates (per 1M tokens) — Round numbers to share with procurement: 
- RW-mid (7–13B): Input $1.00 / Output $2.50
- RW-small (2–4B): Input $0.60 / Output $1.50
- RW-large (70B): Input $2.25 / Output $5.50

Embeddings: priced per 1k vectors (approx $0.50 / 1k vectors for standard dense embeddings) — also available as a per-token option depending on encoder.

Pilot and discounts: we typically offer an introductory pilot credit (varies by ARR potential) and pilot-rate discounts for the first 4–12 weeks. For committed volume discounts we have tiered pricing (examples in the attached workbook):
- 0–1M tokens/day: list rates
- 1–10M tokens/day: ~10% off list with 3–6 month commit
- 10M+ tokens/day: 15–25% off with 6–12 month commit (sliding scale; final depends on model mix)

Attachments: Redwood_Ratecard_Q1_2028.pdf (rate table), novum_commit_scenarios.xlsx (sample discount math).

Happy to set a 30-min call to walk through the numbers and latency tradeoffs — let me know times that work.

Best,
